title: Saved view
purpose: Save the ticket list's current filters and sort as a named view, or rename, share, reorder or delete one of your saved views.
summary: Keep a ticket list you use often. Save the current filters under a name, and choose whether only you, a team or everyone sees it. Supervisors share views.

tasks.title: Save the current list as a view
steps: On the Tickets list, set the filters and sort, then select [[Save view]].
Check the filters listed on this page, type a [[View name]], and select [[Save view]].

tasks.title: Share a view (supervisor)
steps: Under [[Who sees it]] choose A team or Everyone.
For A team, choose the team in [[Team]], then save.

tasks.title: Rename or delete your view
steps: Open the view, then select the link Rename, share or delete under the page heading.
Change the name or sharing and select [[Save changes]], or select [[Delete view]] and confirm.

tasks.title: Reorder your views
steps: On the view's edit page select [[Move up]] or [[Move down]].

good_to_know: A saved view remembers the queue you chose, such as My open, and applies its saved filters. If no queue was specified, it starts from All tickets.
Sharing with a team or everyone is for supervisors. Everyone else can only choose Only me.
A shared view shows each reader only what they may read. Restricted tickets stay hidden from people outside their team.
The edit page changes the name and who sees it, not the filters. To change filters, save a new view.

sections.title: Save view (new)
paragraphs: Opens from the Tickets list. It shows a sentence listing the filters the view will keep, for example Status: Open or waiting, or says the list has no filters so the view shows every ticket you may read. Search text and the order the list showed are kept too, even the default order or one that came from your saved sort, so the view reopens in that order. If the list's filters are invalid the view is refused until they are corrected.

items.label: View name
items.description: Required, up to 80 characters. Each of your views needs its own name ("You already have a view with this name.").

items.label: Who sees it
items.description: Only me (the default), A team or Everyone. Only supervisors (including the admin role) may choose A team or Everyone; for others the list offers only Only me and a request to share is refused.

items.label: Team
items.description: Required for A team: choose an active team. A view shared with a team is seen by that team's members. Ignored for the other choices.

items.label: Save view
items.description: Saves, confirms View saved and opens the list with the view applied. Adds an audit event.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Closes the form and leaves the list as it was drawn; reload it to see a change made in another tab. Where the form opens on a page of its own, Cancel returns to the list you came from, with its view, filters and search, and the sort or rows per page only if you chose them there; your saved sort and page size then apply as they stand, or a saved view's own order.

sections.title: Edit view
paragraphs: Only the view's owner can open the edit page, from the Rename, share or delete link on the list while that view is open. Other people get Not found. The form remembers the version of the view you opened; if it changed since, saving is refused ("This view changed. Reload it.").

items.label: View name and Who sees it and Team
items.description: As above. Saving with nothing changed is refused ("Change the name or who sees it before saving.").

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Saves, confirms View saved and opens the list with the view applied.

items.label: Delete view
items.description: Opens a confirmation naming the view. Cancel returns to the list. Confirming removes the saved view for everyone it is shared with. The tickets stay in their queues. If the view changed since you opened the confirmation, review it before deleting.

items.label: Move up / Move down
items.description: Moves the view one place among your own views, which changes where it sits in the Saved views list. Nothing changes at the top or bottom.

items.label: Saved views in Views
items.description: On the Tickets list the Views menu lists, under Saved views, your own views, views shared with everyone and views shared with a team you belong to. A view shared by someone else shows who it is shared with.

items.label: What a view stores
items.description: The queue, filters, search text and the order the list showed are saved. Opening the view shows that order without changing your own saved sort, unless you sort it another way or follow a view link saved before this was the case. The view's audit event records that it keeps a search, not the search text. Your column choices and page size are separate list preferences.
